caption: The drawing shows a small, rectangular black stove with a short pipe extending vertically from the top and then bending at a right angle to the left. The stove stands on four slender legs, and it has a small rectangular door on the front. Underneath the stove, there is an irregular, oval-shaped red mat or surface. The background of the drawing is a plain beige or light tan color. The majority of the stove and its pipe are colored in shades of dark gray and black, while the red area beneath is solid and contrasts with the neutral background. There is a faint handwritten signature in gray in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Stove
